candidates.title: Escape Sky-high Cost: Early-stopping Self-Consistency for Multi-step Reasoning
candidates.abstract: Self-consistency (SC) has been a widely used decoding strategy for chain-of-thought reasoning. Despite bringing significant performance improvements across a variety of multi-step reasoning tasks, it is a high-cost method that requires multiple sampling with the preset size. In this paper, we propose a simple and scalable sampling process, \textbf{E}arly-Stopping \textbf{S}elf-\textbf{C}onsistency (ESC), to greatly reduce the cost of SC without sacrificing performance. On this basis, one control scheme for ESC is further derivated to dynamically choose the performance-cost balance for different tasks and models. To demonstrate ESC's effectiveness, we conducted extensive experiments on three popular categories of reasoning tasks: arithmetic, commonsense and symbolic reasoning over language models with varying scales. The empirical results show that ESC reduces the average number of sampling of chain-of-thought reasoning by a significant margin on six benchmarks, including MATH (-33.8%), GSM8K (-80.1%), StrategyQA (-76.8%), CommonsenseQA (-78.5%), Coin Flip (-84.2%) and Last Letters (-67.4%), while attaining comparable performances.
candidates.reason: 自己整合性推論の反復samplingを動的早期終了してtest-time計算量を直接削減する推論時conditional-computation方式。
candidates.library_body_check: 本文のESC algorithm・理論・6 benchmark評価を確認。直近w個の回答entropyが0になった時点でsamplingを停止し、最大sample数まで到達した場合だけ通常のmajority voteへ戻る。MATH 33.8%、GSM8K 80.1%、StrategyQA 76.8%、CommonsenseQA 78.5%、Coin Flip 84.2%、Last Letters 67.4%の平均sampling削減を、ほぼ同等の精度で報告する。
